title: Zebra in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- zebra body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='26' ry='16' fill='#f2f7ff'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f2f7ff'/>
  <rect x='42' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e4ecf7'/>
  <rect x='54' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f2f7ff'/>
  <rect x='66' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e4ecf7'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='87' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a8fb5'/>
  <rect x='42' y='87' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a8fb5'/>
  <rect x='54' y='87' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a8fb5'/>
  <rect x='66' y='87' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a8fb5'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <polygon points='62,58 70,42 80,46 74,62' fill='#f2f7ff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='38' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f2f7ff'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='89' cy='39' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#dfe8f5'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='72,30 70,20 76,27' fill='#f2f7ff'/>
  <polygon points='74,20 75,27 78,26' fill='#d9a7b0'/>
  <polygon points='80,28 81,18 85,26' fill='#f2f7ff'/>
  <polygon points='81,18 82,25 85,25' fill='#d9a7b0'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <rect x='69' y='28' width='3' height='4' rx='1' fill='#7a8fb5'/>
  <rect x='68' y='33' width='3' height='4' rx='1' fill='#7a8fb5'/>
  <rect x='67' y='38' width='3' height='4' rx='1' fill='#7a8fb5'/>
  <rect x='66' y='43' width='3' height='4' rx='1' fill='#7a8fb5'/>
  <rect x='66' y='48' width='3' height='4' rx='1' fill='#7a8fb5'/>
  <!-- zebra stripes on body -->
  <path d='M32 56 Q36 62 32 70' stroke='#5a6fa0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 55 Q46 62 42 72' stroke='#5a6fa0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 54 Q56 62 52 74' stroke='#5a6fa0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 54 Q66 62 64 72' stroke='#5a6fa0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stripes on neck -->
  <path d='M66 48 L74 54' stroke='#5a6fa0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 43 L76 49' stroke='#5a6fa0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stripes on head -->
  <path d='M73 34 L78 44' stroke='#5a6fa0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 33 L82 43' stroke='#5a6fa0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M64 54 Q72 58 82 54 Q84 60 80 62 Q70 66 61 60 Z' fill='#ff5a5f'/>
  <path d='M63 60 Q68 66 74 63' fill='#e0484d'/>
  <path d='M66 62 L64 70 L69 68 L67 62 Z' fill='#ff5a5f'/>
  <path d='M64 70 L69 68 L68 73 Z' fill='#e0484d'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <path d='M68 57 L80 55' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M67 62 L78 59' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#2b3a5e'/>
  <circle cx='80.8' cy='34.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='91' cy='38' r='1' fill='#9aa8c4'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M24 62 Q18 60 16 66' stroke='#5a6fa0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='68' r='3' fill='#7a8fb5'/>
</svg>
